create_datastore_for_wikipedia: create a DataStore instance to load Wikipedia corpus data with embeddings and FAISS index for nearest neighbor search
search_embeddings_with_faiss: search the FAISS index with query embeddings to retrieve top-k nearest neighbor token indices and scores
load_token_embeddings: load precomputed token embeddings from a model directory as memory-mapped float16 numpy arrays
train_faiss_index: train an IVFPQ FAISS index on a sampled subset of embeddings using GPU acceleration
get_context_for_token: get the decoded text context around a specific token index using a provided decode function
